Sher Bahadur @ Balle Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.
Deptt. ... on 12 November, 2024

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:74502
Court No. - 7
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11800 of 2024
Applicant :- Sher Bahadur @ Balle Verma
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Home Lko.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Neeraj Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement the on bail in Fir/ Case Crime No.69 of 2024, under Sections
376-Da, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 5g/6 of the Pocso Act and Sections 3(1) (da), 3(1) (Dha), 3(2)
(va), 3(2) (5) of Sc and St Act, Police Station- Sangipur, District Pratapgarh.
3.  Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the co accused Arif Khan @ Arif Ali has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 1.10.2024 passed by this Court.

He lastly argues that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and he is in jail since 22.8.2024, hence he may be enlarged on bail on Sher Bahadur @ Balle Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. ...

entities.text: Sher Bahadur @ Balle Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. Learned A.G.A. opposes the bail application but could not deny the ground of parity.
5.

Considering and adopting the reasonings as contained in bail order of the co accused Arif Khan @
Arif Ali dated 1.10.2024 coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 22.8.2024, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Sher Bahadur @ Balle Verma be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offences of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.11.2024 Shukla  Sher Bahadur @ Balle Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. ... on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51733641/
